title: [BUG] @ file autocomplete has become slow
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.24
- Operating System: macOS
- Terminal: Alacritty

## Bug Description

Entering files with @ used to be snappy. Now it takes nearly a second for matching files to appear after you type `@somepaththatshouldmatch`

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Try to autocomplete a file with @
2. See how it's very slow

## Expected Behavior
It should be instant, like it used to be

## Actual Behavior
It's slow

## Additional Context
author: raine

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: We've identified the issue and will have a fix out tomorrow in 1.0.30.  Thanks for the report and your patience!

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: The fix has been deployed - let us know if it's better after updating.

top_comments.author: raine
top_comments.body: I wonder if this has something to do with postgres mcp stuff having appeared in @ output also at the same time as this problem started.
